notes.title: Patch Notes 0.3.5
notes.content:
We’re excited to share the latest improvements to our game, thanks to your amazing support during Next Fest and the Almaty Geek Games Expo!

What’s new in this update:

[list]
[*] - Improved Zone Buying System:
[*] We’ve upgraded the logic and animations for purchasing zones, making the experience smoother and more immersive.
[*] 
[*] - Progression Loop Fix:
[*] The progression system has been optimized, ensuring a smoother gameplay experience as you advance through the game.
[*] 
[*] - Client Orders Update:
[*] Client arrivals now depend on the type of food you prepare and serve, adding more variety and strategic depth to customer management.
[*] 
[*] - Minor Bug Fixes:
[*] We’ve addressed minor bugs to enhance overall gameplay stability.
[*] 
[*] -Bottle Drop Fixes: 
[*] Improved physics for bottle drops to make them feel more realistic.
[*] 
[*] - Sound Effects Additions:
[*] Added bottle-specific sound effects to enhance immersion.
[*] New sound effects for cups when they are used.
[*] 
[*] - Game Stability Improvements:
[*] We’ve made adjustments to improve the overall stability of the game for a smoother experience.
[/list]

Thank you once again for your trust and support! We couldn’t have made these improvements without your feedback. Keep sharing your thoughts and stay tuned for more updates as we continue refining the game!

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.3.1
notes.content:
We are actively working on improving the game and appreciate your feedback! This patch includes several updates aimed at enhancing gameplay, fixing bugs, and adding more immersive elements. Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to build upon your suggestions and further develop the game.

Patch Notes 0.3.1

[list]
[*] Added weapon zone buying feature
[*] Minor client fixes
[*] Fixed teleport and movement issues
[*] Added graphics settings
[*] New atmospheric sounds added
[/list]

Thank you for your support!

notes.content:
In this patch, we made the following changes:

[*] Tutorial improvements
[*] Environment adjustments

[*] General stability improvements
[/list]
